## Independent exact correction review — ONE corrected KVM base prerequisite observation

**Reviewer:** `claude-opus-5`, fresh context, actual identity, read-only. I executed nothing, opened no device, computed no digest, delegated nothing, changed no source, freeze, guard, image or permission. All hashes/byte counts are **supplied recorded values**; my contribution is line-by-line inspection of the changed source, the negative tests, both TDD logs and the failed receipt. The preserved C1-recheck review, `full-base-kvm-runtime/result.json` and its `stderr.log` are untouched and remain the authoritative failed observation.

# Verdict: **APPROVED** — for precisely one corrected base prerequisite run, nothing else

## What I verified, not assumed

- **The failure is our own predicate, as claimed.** `result.json` shows `error_type: ValueError`, `error_category: "unexpected host descriptor or KVM identity"`, `fd_inventory` ending at `anon_inode:kvm-vcpu-stats:0`, `serial_bytes 0` with the empty-string SHA, `qmp_events []`, `owned_process_stopped true`, and `stderr.log` showing only SIGTERM from the owning `python3` (pid 2597587 → child 2597629). No ioctl error, no device denial, no tool refusal, no guest execution. `actual_uid/gid` 1003/994, groups [1004], `CapEff 0000000000000000`, `NoNewPrivs 1`, `Seccomp 2` were verified before the stop. The inventory order (`kvm-vcpu:0`, eventfd, eventfd, `kvm-vcpu-stats:0`) also corroborates one stats fd per vCPU, so `[0-3]` matches the pinned `-smp 4` in the same file.
- **The new branch is narrowing, not a bypass.** `re.fullmatch(r'anon_inode:kvm-vcpu-stats:[0-3]')` cannot match any path (no `/` prefix reachable), so `/dev/kvm` identity, the path allowlist and the generic anon-inode regex are unchanged; `kvm-vcpu-stats:4`/`:10` fall through and are rejected by the final regex. Metadata is mandatory: non-`str` or >4096 → `False`; exactly one `^flags:` line required; `int(flags,8)==os.O_CLOEXEC` (0o2000000) means read-only is enforced by equality, since `O_RDONLY==0` and any write bit or missing CLOEXEC changes the value. The `^…$` MULTILINE anchors cannot be satisfied by a non-`flags:` line.
- **Only metadata is read.** `(p.parent.parent/'fdinfo'/p.name)` resolves to `/proc/<owned pid>/fdinfo/N`, bounded `read(4097)`, of the owned child only; the descriptor itself is never read, never ioctl'd (the kernel object exposes read/release/seek only), and no Android maps/proc/`run-as` operation reappears.
- **No execution/device/sandbox/permission delta.** argv, env, `-sandbox on,…deny`, `-S`, rlimits, `/dev/kvm` metadata gate, tree manifest, library/QEMU/kernel/initrd hash gates and all budgets are byte-identical in the diff.
- **Old evidence cannot be overwritten.** New `out=E/'full-base-kvm-stats-fixed-runtime'` with `mkdir(mode=0o700)` and no `exist_ok`; `console.log` opened `'x'`. Freeze ↔ dropper literal ↔ frozen source header agree on `024dcdd7…`, and dropper `6bdfc730…` matches the freeze entry.
- **TDD is genuine.** RED is a real `TypeError: allowed_fd() got an unexpected keyword argument 'stats_fdinfo'` — the test predates the signature. GREEN lists 13 named tests, which is exactly the count in the supplied test file (7 Archive + 2 Dropper + 4 BootPredicates). Six negatives cover absent metadata, out-of-range index, write access, missing CLOEXEC, duplicate `flags:` and a socket carrying valid metadata.

## Nonblocking findings

- **N1 (most likely repeat-failure cause):** `02000000` is derived from upstream sources, **not** from an actual observation — the failed run captured no fdinfo. If the running kernel prints any additional bit, the run fails again at the same predicate. That is fail-closed and acceptable; it is a **recorded failed observation, not a retry trigger**, and any further change needs a new review.
- **N2:** the `except FileNotFoundError` covers only `readlink`; a descriptor closing between readlink and the fdinfo open raises an uncaught `FileNotFoundError` → `GUEST_PREREQUISITES_FAILED`. Fail-closed; a second transient surface alongside the already-accepted point-in-time fd trip.
- **N3:** two behaviours correct by inspection but untested — the >4096 bound and a fdinfo with no `flags:` line at all (`len(flags)==0`).
- **N4:** `[0-3]` is coupled to `-smp 4` in the same frozen file; consistent today, brittle if smp ever changes. The pre-existing `kvm-vcpu(?::[0-9]+)?` index is still unbounded — unchanged, out of scope.

## Preserved status

One run on the unchanged image, guest script and scope. C2 (`TimeoutStartSec=300` under the ~540 s command maxima) stands as owner-accepted single-run risk: a timeout is a failed observation retained in full, never PASS, never auto-retried. Strict-UTF-8 decode, 20 GiB `MemAvailable` bound, `panic=-1`/`-no-reboot`, `ip -j` shape, A1–A4/B1–B4 closures and `isolation_claim: OBSERVED_POINT_IN_TIME_NOT_ENFORCEMENT` are unchanged. `-accel-check` success remains `AVAILABLE_NOT_ANDROID_ACCEPTANCE` only. No relay, veth, netns, ADB, AVD, packet driver, current call, deployment, merge or ADR acceptance is transferred. `nested_android`, `current_calls`, TURN-RT01/ACL02, relay lifecycle, coordinator rehearsal, CALL-CURRENT01, hosted installation remain **NOT RUN**; CALL-CONNECT01 **OPEN**; prior refusals intact and unretried; RFC-0018/ADR-0012 `proposed`.
